name: Harley-Davidson Tri Glide / Freewheeler
engine: Twin Cam or Milwaukee-Eight V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive, two rear wheels
intro: Harley's factory trikes. Two rear wheels, a reverse gear and the touring bike underneath.

K: The trike has its own rear brake setup and parking brake. Use the trike service manual, not the two-wheeler one.

recallNote: Harley-Davidson has issued several recalls that touch these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
